facility.name: Rollingbrook Rehabilitation and Health Care Center

top_deficiency_types.title: Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Coordinate assessments with the pre-admission screening and resident review program; and referring for services as needed.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.
Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.
Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.
Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.
Assess the resident completely in a timely manner  when first admitted, and then periodically, at least every 12 months.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies
